title: Golden Avocado Toast
description: Crisp sourdough topped with mashed avocado, chili flakes, and a poached egg.
ingredients: 2 slices sourdough, 1 ripe avocado, 2 eggs, chili flakes, lemon juice, salt, pepper, parsley
steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp. Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Poach or fry the eggs, then layer everything on the toast and finish with parsley and chili flakes.

title: Berry Yogurt Parfait
description: Layered Greek yogurt, granola, and fresh berries for a quick bright breakfast.
ingredients: Greek yogurt, mixed berries, granola, honey, chia seeds
steps: Spoon yogurt into glasses, add berries and granola in layers, then drizzle honey and sprinkle chia seeds on top.

title: Maple Banana Pancakes
description: Soft pancakes topped with banana slices and warm maple syrup.
ingredients: flour, milk, eggs, banana, baking powder, maple syrup, butter
steps: Mix the batter, cook small pancakes on a skillet, and serve with banana slices and maple syrup.

title: Roasted Vegetable Pasta
description: Pasta tossed with roasted vegetables and a light garlic herb sauce.
ingredients: pasta, zucchini, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, parmesan, basil
steps: Roast the vegetables until caramelized. Boil the pasta, toss with garlic oil, and combine everything with parmesan and basil.

title: Crispy Chickpea Salad Bowl
description: Crunchy chickpeas, greens, cucumber, and a lemony dressing.
ingredients: chickpeas, mixed greens, cucumber, tomato, red onion, lemon, olive oil, cumin
steps: Roast the chickpeas with spices until crisp. Toss with greens and vegetables, then finish with lemon dressing.

title: Tomato Basil Soup
description: Silky tomato soup served with toasted bread and fresh herbs.
ingredients: tomatoes, onion, garlic, vegetable broth, cream, basil, bread
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add tomatoes and broth, then simmer until tender. Blend until smooth, stir in cream, and serve with basil and toast.

title: Herb Turkey Burger
description: Juicy turkey patties served with lettuce, tomato, and pickles.
ingredients: ground turkey, bread buns, lettuce, tomato, pickles, onion, garlic powder, paprika
steps: Mix the turkey with seasoning, form patties, and cook until browned. Serve on buns with vegetables and sauces.

title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
description: Silky pasta with garlic, parmesan, and roasted cherry tomatoes.
ingredients: pasta, garlic, butter, cream, parmesan, cherry tomatoes, parsley
steps: Cook the pasta and reserve a bit of water. Sauté garlic, stir in cream and parmesan, then toss with pasta and tomatoes until glossy.

title: Honey Glazed Salmon
description: Baked salmon glazed with honey, soy, and ginger.
ingredients: salmon fillets, honey, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sesame seeds, broccoli
steps: Mix the glaze and brush over the salmon. Bake until flaky and serve with roasted broccoli and sesame seeds.

title: Spiced Vegetable Curry
description: A hearty curry with chickpeas, spinach, and coconut milk.
ingredients: chickpeas, onion, garlic, curry paste, coconut milk, spinach, rice
steps: Sauté onion and garlic, add curry paste, then stir in chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer until thick and add spinach before serving with rice.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers filled with rice, beef, herbs, and tomato sauce.
ingredients: bell peppers, ground beef, rice, tomato sauce, onion, garlic, oregano
steps: Cook the filling, stuff the halved peppers, and bake until tender. Serve hot with herbs on top.

title: Lemon Rosemary Chicken
description: Roasted chicken thighs with lemon, rosemary, and roasted potatoes.
ingredients: chicken thighs, lemon, rosemary, garlic, potatoes, olive oil, salt, pepper
steps: Marinate the chicken with lemon, garlic, and rosemary. Roast with potatoes until golden and serve with pan juices.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten center and vanilla ice cream.
ingredients: dark chocolate, butter, sugar, eggs, flour, vanilla ice cream
steps: Melt chocolate and butter, whisk with eggs and sugar, fold in flour, and bake until the edges are set and the center is gooey.

title: Lemon Berry Tart
description: Buttery tart shell filled with lemon custard and fresh berries.
ingredients: tart shell, lemons, sugar, butter, eggs, blueberries, strawberries
steps: Bake the tart shell, prepare the lemon filling, and fill the shell before topping with berries.

title: Crispy Flatbread Bites
description: Warm flatbread topped with herbs, garlic, and cheese for sharing.
ingredients: flatbread, garlic, olive oil, mozzarella, oregano, parsley
steps: Brush flatbread with oil and garlic, add cheese and herbs, then bake until crisp and bubbly.

title: Garden Herb Focaccia
description: Soft focaccia with rosemary, olives, and sea salt.
ingredients: bread flour, yeast, olive oil, rosemary, olives, sea salt
steps: Mix and knead the dough, proof it, then top with herbs and olives before baking until golden.
